agentbench api: JSON command-line interface for scripts and external testing agents. Commands return structured JSON on stdout; execution logs go to stderr.
agentbench api agent: Read a registered agent’s source revision, framework, status, case limits, and task context.
agentbench api prepare: Prepare an agent’s source at a specified Git revision and return the prepared target metadata without running test cases.
agentbench api execute: Run an abb.cases.v1 case collection against one agent, save execution evidence, and optionally invoke a Judge.
agentbench api result: Read a saved Suite’s result snapshot and run metadata without executing the agent again.
agentbench api evidence: Read one run’s validated Judge request, derived trajectory, trace spans, and evaluation data.
agentbench api attachment: Read the text content and metadata of a registered Judge evidence attachment from a saved run.
agentbench api submit-judge: Validate and save an external Judge report for a completed, host-accepted execution with no assigned Judge.
agentbench api gt: Match saved Suite execution evidence against the agent’s ground-truth failures without rerunning the agent.
